content:
**Meadow Breeze Sprayer** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

The Meadow Breeze Sprayer was created by Abraxodyne Chemical in collaboration with the United States Government military on the Meadow Breeze project.

The Meadow Breeze Sprayer is a variant of the Plasma Rifle.

During the quest Dirty Laundry, the Vault Dweller can find Abraxodyne Intel cases scattered around Burning Springs. At Tycoon Lake, the Meadow Breeze Sprayer can be collected when picking up the Intel case inside the shed of the Abraxodyne pump station at the top of the hill.
